site.title: MIBH Montreal — Islamic Community Center
site.subtitle: Twelver Shia Islamic Center in Montreal
site.description: A Twelver Shia Islamic community dedicated to faith, knowledge, service, and unity.

home.heroSubtitle: Twelver Shia Islamic Center in Montreal
home.heroDescription: A Twelver Shia Islamic community dedicated to faith, knowledge, service, and unity. Our mission is to strengthen the spiritual, educational, and social well-being of Muslims while promoting understanding, compassion, and community engagement.
home.aboutDescription: A Shia Islamic organization committed to serving the community through religious education, spiritual development, charitable initiatives, and community engagement.
home.aboutText: We strive to provide a welcoming environment where individuals and families can strengthen their connection with Allah, deepen their understanding of Islam, and contribute positively to society.
home.beliefsDescription: The foundation of Shia Islamic belief rests upon five essential principles.
home.tawhidDesc: Oneness of Allah — He is One, unique, and without partner.
home.adalahDesc: Divine Justice — Allah is perfectly just and fair in all matters.
home.nubuwwahDesc: Prophethood — Allah sent prophets to guide humanity.
home.imamahDesc: Leadership — After the Prophet (PBUH), leadership continued through the Twelve Imams.
home.qiyamahDesc: Day of Judgment — Every person will be accountable before Allah.
home.programsDescription: We offer a variety of programs for all ages — from weekly religious gatherings to youth leadership and community services.
home.servicesDescription: We are here to support the community through life's most important moments.
home.supportDescription: Your contributions help us maintain our center, support educational programs, organize community events, and assist families in need. Every contribution makes a difference.
home.weeklyDesc: Regular gatherings to strengthen faith and community bonds.
home.youthDesc: Empowering the next generation of Muslim leaders.
home.womensDesc: Creating spaces for sisters to learn and connect.
home.childrensDesc: Nurturing young hearts with Islamic values.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Who We Are
about.description: MIBH Montreal is a Shia Islamic organization committed to serving the community through religious education, spiritual development, charitable initiatives, and community engagement.
about.storyDescription: Building a community rooted in the teachings of the Holy Qur'an and the Ahlul Bayt (AS).
about.faithDesc: Deepening our connection with Allah (SWT) through worship, learning, and practice of the teachings of the Holy Qur'an and Ahlul Bayt (AS).
about.knowledgeDesc: Promoting Islamic education for all ages — from Quranic studies to understanding the rich traditions of Shia Islam.
about.serviceDesc: Serving our community through charitable initiatives, support programs, and outreach that embody Islamic values of compassion.
about.unityDesc: Building a welcoming and inclusive community where all Muslims can come together, support one another, and grow in faith.
about.weeklyGatheringsDesc: Join us every Friday for congregational prayers followed by community discussions, Quran recitation, and fellowship.
about.servingMontrealDesc: We are proud to serve the diverse Muslim community of Montreal, building bridges of understanding and cooperation across cultures.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.subtitle: Purpose & Vision
mission.description: Guided by the teachings of the Holy Qur'an and the Ahlul Bayt (AS), we are committed to serving our community and humanity at large.
mission.missionText: To inspire faith, promote knowledge, support those in need, and build a united Muslim community rooted in the teachings of the Holy Qur'an and the Ahlul Bayt (AS).
mission.visionText: To become a leading Islamic center that nurtures future generations, strengthens families, and serves as a beacon of guidance and compassion.
mission.inspireFaithDesc: Strengthen the spiritual foundation of individuals and families through worship, education, and connection to Islamic teachings.
mission.promoteKnowledgeDesc: Provide authentic Islamic education rooted in the Holy Qur'an and the teachings of the Ahlul Bayt (AS) for all ages.
mission.supportNeedyDesc: Extend a helping hand through charitable initiatives, counseling, and community support programs.
mission.buildUnityDesc: Foster a united Muslim community where diversity is celebrated and brotherhood/sisterhood is strengthened.
mission.quote: The best of people are those who are most beneficial to others.

beliefs.title: The 12 Shia Beliefs
beliefs.subtitle: Roots of Faith
beliefs.description: Understanding the core principles of Shia Islam — Usul al-Din (Roots of Religion) and the divinely guided leadership of the Twelve Imams (AS).
beliefs.usulDescription: The five essential roots of religion in Shia Islam that form the foundation of our belief system.
beliefs.imamsDescription: The divinely appointed leaders who guided the Muslim community after Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).

programs.title: Programs & Activities
programs.subtitle: Get Involved
programs.description: From weekly religious gatherings to youth leadership and community services, there is something for everyone at MIBH Montreal.
programs.weeklyDescription: Join us throughout the week for prayers, learning, and community fellowship.
programs.youthDescription: Building confident, knowledgeable, and service-minded young Muslims who are proud of their faith.
programs.womensDescription: Creating nurturing spaces for women to learn, connect, and grow spiritually.
programs.childrensDescription: Planting the seeds of faith in our children through engaging and meaningful programs.
programs.communityDescription: We are committed to supporting our community through life's most important moments.
programs.marriageDesc: Islamic marriage (Nikah) ceremonies performed in accordance with Shia traditions.
programs.funeralDesc: Compassionate funeral and burial assistance following Islamic guidelines.
programs.counselingDesc: Spiritual and family counseling rooted in Islamic teachings and values.
programs.newMuslimDesc: Welcoming and supporting new reverts on their journey of faith.
programs.familyDesc: Resources and support for strengthening Muslim family relationships.
programs.outreachDesc: Building bridges through interfaith dialogue and community service.

prayer.title: Prayer Times
prayer.subtitle: Montreal, Quebec
prayer.description: Daily prayer times for our community. Join us at the center for congregational prayers.
prayer.jumuahDesc: Join us every Friday for the congregational Jumu'ah prayer. Stay after for community discussions and fellowship.
prayer.phase2Note: Coming in Phase 2: Live prayer times via API integration, automatic monthly timetable generation, and Iqamah time notifications.

events.title: Events Calendar
events.subtitle: Stay Connected
events.description: Join us for prayers, commemorations, celebrations, and community gatherings throughout the Islamic year.
events.neverMissDesc: Event dates follow the Islamic lunar calendar. Subscribe to our newsletter or follow us on social media for the latest updates.

donations.title: Support Our Mission
donations.subtitle: Make a Difference
donations.description: Your donations help us maintain our center, support educational programs, organize community events, and assist families in need.
donations.impactDescription: Every dollar you contribute makes a meaningful difference in our community.
donations.optionsDescription: Choose the giving method that works best for you. Every contribution, no matter the size, is valuable.
donations.oneTimeDesc: Make a single contribution of any amount to support our ongoing programs and services.
donations.monthlyDesc: Set up a recurring monthly contribution to provide sustained support for our community initiatives.
donations.zakatDesc: Fulfill your Zakat obligation through MIBH. We ensure your Zakat reaches those who are eligible according to Islamic law.
donations.sadaqahDesc: Give voluntary charity (Sadaqah) to support various community programs and families in need.
donations.sponsorshipDesc: Sponsor a child's education, a youth program, or an educational initiative for lasting impact.
donations.buildingFundDesc: Contribute to the development and maintenance of our Islamic center for future generations.
donations.otherWaysText: For bank transfers, in-person donations, or to discuss larger contributions, please contact us directly.

volunteer.title: Become a Volunteer
volunteer.subtitle: Serve Your Community
volunteer.description: Help us strengthen our community by volunteering your time, skills, and energy.
volunteer.opportunitiesDescription: No matter your skills or experience, there is a place for you to contribute.
volunteer.eventsTeamDesc: Help organize and run community events, religious programs, and celebrations.
volunteer.educationProgramsDesc: Assist with Quran classes, Islamic studies, tutoring, and educational workshops.
volunteer.youthActivitiesDesc: Mentor young Muslims, coach sports teams, and lead discussions.
volunteer.mediaTeamDesc: Contribute to social media, photography, videography, and graphic design.
volunteer.communityOutreachDesc: Participate in interfaith initiatives, food drives, and new Muslim support.
volunteer.fundraisingDesc: Help plan and execute fundraising campaigns and events.
volunteer.signupDescription: Fill out the form below and we'll get in touch with you about volunteer opportunities.

contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.subtitle: Contact Us
contact.description: We would love to hear from you. Reach out regarding programs, donations, volunteering, religious questions, or community support.

footer.description: A Shia Islamic community dedicated to faith, knowledge, service, and unity in Montreal.
